editorial:
Imagine living in a fancy apartment for twenty years without ever stepping foot outside. That is the wild life of the main character in this story, a rich heiress who is terrified of the world. You get to see her weird, sheltered bubble burst when a neighbor is murdered right under her nose. A detective shows up to figure out what happened, and he basically forces her to stop hiding and start talking. It feels like a classic mystery where you are trying to piece together the puzzle along with the characters in a high-end New York building.

The acting is solid and the mystery keeps you guessing for most of the runtime. While it moves a bit slowly at times, the twists make it worth your while. If you like stories about secrets and rich people with hidden problems, you will love this one. You can grab it as a rental on Apple TV or stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality. If you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great move to see all the detail in those fancy rooms.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the heiress was not just scared; she was being manipulated and controlled by people she trusted. The detective discovers that the murder was linked to a larger plot to keep her trapped and steal her wealth. In the end, the truth comes out, the bad guys are caught, and she finally finds the courage to leave her apartment and face the real world for the first time in decades.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisty mysteries and character studies.
